+import pytest

+import click
+from click.core import UNSET
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", [click.Option, click.Argument])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mapped, expected", [(None, None), ("007", "007"), (UNSET, 12)])
+def test_info_context_defaults(kind, mapped, expected):
+    decl = ["--value"] if kind is click.Option else ["value"]
+    param = kind(decl, type=int, default=12)
+    command = click.Command("cmd", params=[param], add_help_option=False)
+    default_map = {"value": mapped}
+    ctx = click.Context(command, default_map=default_map)
+    standalone = param.to_info_dict()
+
+    info = command.to_info_dict(ctx)["params"][0]
+    assert info == {**standalone, "default": expected}
+    assert ctx.to_info_dict()["command"]["params"][0] == info
+    assert param.to_info_dict() == standalone
+    assert param.default == 12
+    assert default_map["value"] is mapped
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", [click.Option, click.Argument])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("in_map", [False, True])
+def test_info_factories_remain_lazy(kind, in_map):
+    def factory():
+        raise AssertionError("introspection executed a factory")
+
+    decl = ["--value"] if kind is click.Option else ["value"]
+    declared = 12 if in_map else factory
+    param = kind(decl, type=int, default=declared)
+    command = click.Command("cmd", params=[param], add_help_option=False)
+    default_map = {"value": factory} if in_map else {}
+    ctx = click.Context(command, default_map=default_map)
+
+    assert command.to_info_dict(ctx)["params"][0]["default"] is factory
+    assert ctx.to_info_dict()["command"]["params"][0]["default"] is factory
+    assert param.to_info_dict()["default"] is declared
+    assert param.default is declared
+
+
+def test_info_option_lazy_defaults():

+        raise AssertionError("introspection executed a flag value")
+
+    params = [
+        click.Option(["--enabled"], is_flag=True),
+        click.Option(["--disabled"], is_flag=True),
+        click.Option(["--mode"], flag_value=activation, default=False),
+        click.Option(["--many"], flag_value="x", multiple=True),
+        click.Option(["--count"], count=True),
+        click.Option(["--missing"]),
+        click.Argument(["absent"], required=False),
+    ]
+    command = click.Command("cmd", params=params, add_help_option=False)
+    ctx = click.Context(command, default_map={"disabled": None, "mode": True})
+    before = [param.to_info_dict() for param in params]

+def test_info_nested_context_defaults():

+        raise AssertionError("nested introspection executed a factory")

+
+    leaf = click.Command(
+        "leaf",
+        params=[
+            option(3),
+            click.Argument(["target"], default="declared"),

spec.question:
Make Click's structured documentation reflect context-specific defaults. In the parameter dictionaries returned by Command.to_info_dict(ctx), each default field should report that parameter's effective default for the supplied context, using its get_default behavior with callable evaluation disabled. This must also work when documentation is obtained through Context.to_info_dict() or recursively through Group.to_info_dict(ctx), using each nested command's own context and inherited default_map.

Explicit None entries in default_map must override declared defaults. Missing entries and entries containing the internal UNSET sentinel must retain the existing default-resolution rules, including lazy option defaults; any unresolved UNSET must be exposed as None. Preserve callable default factories and callable flag activation values as the original objects without executing them. Do not type-convert defaults or use parsed parameter values or environment values instead. Preserve all other parameter metadata, including metadata supplied by subclasses, and honor overridden get_default methods. Standalone Parameter.to_info_dict() and Option.to_info_dict() must remain context-free and retain their current behavior, without changing declared defaults or default maps.

Return a unified diff against production files only; leave tests unchanged.
